sql_schemas: table employee | fields: id, first_name, last_name, email, role, manager_id, department, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: manager_id -> employee.id | indexes: email: unique lookup for authentication and duplicate prevention; manager_id: frequent queries for direct reports and org hierarchy; role: RBAC filtering at query level (GP-005)

table leave_balance | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type, year, total_days, used_days, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employee.id | indexes: employee_id, leave_type, year: unique composite lookup for balance queries per employee per type per year; employee_id: all balance queries are scoped to an employee

table leave_request | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type, start_date, end_date, days_requested, status, reason, reviewer_id, reviewed_at, review_comment, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employee.id; reviewer_id -> employee.id | indexes: employee_id: all leave requests are queried per employee; status: filtering by pending/approved/rejected for manager dashboards; reviewer_id: manager workload queries — all requests awaiting a specific reviewer; start_date, end_date: date-range queries for overlap detection and calendar views; leave_type: filtering and aggregation by leave category

table leave_policy | fields: id, leave_type, max_days_per_year, max_consecutive_days, requires_approval, allow_negative_balance, notice_days_required, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | indexes: leave_type: unique lookup for policy enforcement during leave application; is_active: filtering active policies only

table audit_log | fields: id, entity_type, entity_id, action, actor_id, changes, timestamp | pk: id | fks: actor_id -> employee.id | indexes: entity_type, entity_id: audit trail lookups for a specific entity; actor_id: audit queries by user; timestamp: time-range audit queries; action: filtering by action type (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE)

methods: findByEmployeeTypeYear(employeeId: string, leaveType: string, year: number): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>
findOverlapping(employeeId: string, startDate: Date, endDate: Date): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>
updateStatus(id: string, status: string, reviewerId: string, comment?: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>

data_notes: All five tables (employee, leave_balance, leave_request, leave_policy, audit_log) are defined conceptually — field names only, no SQL types, no DDL. The employee table is defined once and referenced by FK from leave_balance, leave_request, and audit_log. Index rationale reflects access patterns: employee lookups by email/role/manager, leave-balance composite uniqueness, leave-request filtering by status/reviewer/date-range, policy lookup by leave_type, and audit trail by entity/actor/timestamp. Five repository interfaces each name a concrete Pg*Repository backed by PostgreSQL via the existing pg Pool at src/shared/db/connection.ts. Audit log repository satisfies GP-002; all DB access through repositories satisfies GP-001.
